title: Make Welcome Goal Library modal goal list scrollable for new users

requirements.text: Fix the Welcome Goal Library popup (GoalLibraryModal) so the goal template list is actually scrollable when the modal opens, allowing a newly logged-in user to scroll through and select goals beyond the initially visible items.

quotes: When a new user logs in and then the welcome pop-up comes up, the list of goals there, when it shows the first goal on the screen, it doesn't scroll. The user cannot scroll and select other goals. It should be scrollable.

acceptanceCriteria: When the GoalLibraryModal opens, the goal list area supports scrolling via mouse wheel/trackpad on desktop.
On touch devices, the goal list area supports vertical swipe scrolling inside the modal.
Scrolling does not move the page behind the modal; only the list scrolls.
Users can scroll to any goal template in the current tab/category and select it (checkbox or card click) without the modal closing unintentionally.
The modal header/tabs area and footer action buttons remain visible while the list scrolls (i.e., only the list region scrolls).

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose and configure existing shadcn components instead).
Keep the backend unchanged; this is a frontend scroll/interaction fix only.
nonGoals: Adding new onboarding steps or changing which modal opens when.
Changing goal template content or categories.
Implementing new authentication or profile flows.
